result.requirement: The system shall enable the Delivery Partner to execute the physical movement of goods from the Store Partner to the Customer and generate verifiable proof of delivery.
result.business_need: The business needs to conclusively close the logistics loop by verifying successful handover and triggering financial settlement.
functional_behaviour: The system shall assign a specific Delivery Assignment to a Delivery Partner based on the active linkage between a ready Order Request and the agent's current workload status.
The system shall allow the Delivery Partner to navigate the assigned route and access the specific list of items selected by the customer along with any special handling notes.
The system shall enable the Delivery Partner to capture verifiable evidence of physical goods reaching the customer, such as a digital signature, timestamped photo, or automated confirmation code.
The system shall update the status of the Fulfillment Task to 'Completed' only after the Delivery Partner submits valid Delivery Proof.
The system shall notify the Customer Profile of the successful handover and the generated proof details.
The system shall trigger the finalization of the Financial Transaction Record upon validation of the Delivery Proof.
related_information_requirements: The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer.
The active linkage between a ready order and a specific delivery agent, including the assigned route, estimated arrival time, and the agent's current workload status.
The internal record confirming that the store has successfully picked, verified, and packed the order, and has formally transferred possession to a delivery agent.
Verifiable evidence that the physical goods have reached the customer, such as a digital signature, timestamped photo, or automated confirmation code.
business_rules: A Fulfillment Task cannot be marked as completed without a valid Delivery Proof record.
The system must capture a timestamp and geolocation for every piece of Delivery Proof submitted.
The Delivery Partner must verify the specific list of items against the Order Request before generating proof.
Financial settlement is triggered only after the Delivery Proof is validated by the system.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner has picked up an Order Request and is at the customer's location
acceptance_criteria.when: The Delivery Partner submits a timestamped photo and digital signature via the system
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the Fulfillment Task status to completed and triggers the Financial Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Partner attempts to submit proof for an Order Request where the items do not match the Order Request
acceptance_criteria.when: The Delivery Partner tries to finalize the Delivery Assignment
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the submission and prevents the Fulfillment Task from being marked as completed
